hits.title: Cracker Barrel Announces CEO Succession
hits.snippet: # Cracker Barrel Announces CEO Succession _David Deno Appointed Next CEO, Effective August 10, 2026_ ("Cracker Barrel" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: CBRL) today announced that, following a comprehensive succession planning and search process, David Deno has been appointed to serve as the Company's next Chief Executive Officer and will join the Board of Directors (the "Board"), both effective August 10, 2026.
